<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500;600&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  color-scheme: light;
  
  --purple:#6B3FD8; --purple-700:#5530B8; --purple-900:#2A1670;
  --yellow:#FCC305; --yellow-200:#FFE58A; --yellow-ink:#5C4500;
  --lilac:#EDE6FF; --lilac-2:#DCCFFF;
  --mint:#D7F5E4; --mint-ink:#0E5A35;
  
  --ink:#0E0B1A; --ink-2:#37324A; --ink-3:#5B5670;
  --canvas:#FFFFFF; --soft:#F6F5F9; --line:#E6E3EE; --line-2:#D3CFDF;
  
  --sans:"Plus Jakarta Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;
  
  --r-xs:8px; --r-sm:12px; --r:20px; --r-lg:32px; --pill:999px;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
  --wrap:1240px;
  --focus:0 0 0 3px #fff,0 0 0 5px var(--purple);
}
.vueme-page *,.vueme-page *::before,.vueme-page *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.vueme-page *{margin:0}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{font-family:var(--sans);color:var(--ink);background:var(--canvas);font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.vueme-page img,.vueme-page svg{display:block;max-width:100%}
.vueme-page img{height:auto}
.vueme-page a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.vueme-page button,.vueme-page input,.vueme-page select,.vueme-page textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
.vueme-page button{cursor:pointer;background:none;border:0}
.vueme-page :focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--focus);border-radius:8px}
.vueme-page [hidden]{display:none!important}
.vueme-page .sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.vueme-page .skip{position:absolute;left:12px;top:-60px;z-index:100;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:var(--pill)}
.vueme-page .skip:focus{top:12px}
.vueme-page .wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.vueme-page h1,.vueme-page h2,.vueme-page h3,.vueme-page h4{line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.025em;text-wrap:balance;font-weight:800}
.vueme-page p{text-wrap:pretty}
.vueme-page .eyebrow{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-2)}
.vueme-page .tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:28px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:var(--pill);background:var(--yellow);color:var(--ink);font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.vueme-page .tag.soft{background:var(--yellow-200)}
.vueme-page .tag.lilac{background:var(--lilac);color:var(--purple-900)}
.vueme-page .tag.mint{background:var(--mint);color:var(--mint-ink)}
.vueme-page .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:48px;padding:0 24px;border-radius:var(--pill);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;transition:background-color .18s,color .18s,transform .18s var(--ease),box-shadow .18s}
.vueme-page .btn svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}
.vueme-page .btn:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.vueme-page .btn-primary{background:var(--purple);color:#fff}
.vueme-page .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--purple-700)}
.vueme-page .btn-ink{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.vueme-page .btn-ink:hover{background:#2a2540}
.vueme-page .btn-yellow{background:var(--yellow);color:var(--ink)}
.vueme-page .btn-yellow:hover{background:#FFD23A}
.vueme-page .btn-white{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ink)}
.vueme-page .btn-white:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.vueme-page .btn-ghost{color:var(--ink);background:transparent}
.vueme-page .btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--soft)}
.vueme-page .btn-sm{min-height:40px;padding:0 16px;font-size:14px}
.vueme-page .btn-lg{min-height:56px;padding:0 30px;font-size:16px}
.vueme-page .icon-btn{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:background-color .18s}
.vueme-page .icon-btn:hover{background:var(--soft)}
.vueme-page .icon-btn svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.vueme-page .promo{background:var(--yellow);color:var(--ink);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;text-align:center;padding:9px 16px}
.vueme-page .promo a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.vueme-page .site-nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:40;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);backdrop-filter:saturate(1.5) blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.vueme-page .site-nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;height:68px}
.vueme-page .logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:800;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.vueme-page .logo img{height:24px;width:auto}
.vueme-page .nav-links{display:flex;gap:4px}
.vueme-page .nav-links a{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:var(--pill);font-weight:600;font-size:15px;transition:background-color .18s}
.vueme-page .nav-links a:hover{background:var(--soft)}
.vueme-page .nav-links a[aria-current="page"]{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.vueme-page .nav-end{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.vueme-page .nav-menu{display:none}
.vueme-page .mnav{display:none;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 24px 16px;background:#fff}
.vueme-page .mnav.open{display:block}
.vueme-page .mnav a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:48px;font-weight:600;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.vueme-page .field{display:grid;gap:6px}
.vueme-page .field label,.vueme-page .label{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.vueme-page .field .hint{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.vueme-page .input,.vueme-page .select,.vueme-page .textarea{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px;border:1.5px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:#fff;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.vueme-page .textarea{min-height:84px;resize:vertical}
.vueme-page .input:hover,.vueme-page .select:hover,.vueme-page .textarea:hover{border-color:var(--ink-3)}
.vueme-page .input:focus,.vueme-page .select:focus,.vueme-page .textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--purple);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(107,63,216,.18)}
.vueme-page .seg{display:inline-flex;padding:4px;border-radius:var(--pill);background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.vueme-page .seg button,.vueme-page .seg label{min-height:38px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:var(--pill);font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-2);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,color .15s}
.vueme-page .seg input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.vueme-page .seg [aria-pressed="true"],.vueme-page .seg [aria-selected="true"],.vueme-page .seg input:checked+span{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.vueme-page .seg label:has(input:checked){background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.vueme-page .seg label:has(input:focus-visible){box-shadow:var(--focus)}
.vueme-page .swatches{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.vueme-page .swatch{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--line-2);cursor:pointer;position:relative}
.vueme-page .swatch input{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}
.vueme-page .swatch:has(input:checked){box-shadow:0 0 0 2.5px var(--ink)}
.vueme-page .swatch:has(input:focus-visible){box-shadow:var(--focus)}
.vueme-page .check{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:14px;border:1.5px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:var(--r-sm);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,background-color .15s}
.vueme-page .check:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--soft)}
.vueme-page .check input{width:20px;height:20px;accent-color:var(--purple);margin-top:2px;flex:none}
.vueme-page .check b{display:block;font-size:15px}
.vueme-page .check span{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.vueme-page .check .price{margin-left:auto;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.vueme-page .panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r)}
.vueme-page .block{border-radius:var(--r-lg)}
.vueme-page .block-purple{background:var(--purple);color:#fff}
.vueme-page .block-yellow{background:var(--yellow);color:var(--ink)}
.vueme-page .block-lilac{background:var(--lilac);color:var(--ink)}
.vueme-page .block-ink{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.vueme-page .block-mint{background:var(--mint);color:var(--ink)}
.vueme-page .site-foot{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:72px 0 32px;margin-top:0}
.vueme-page .site-foot a{color:#E7E4F2}
.vueme-page .site-foot a:hover{color:#fff;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.vueme-page .foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1.2fr;gap:40px}
.vueme-page .foot-grid h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#BDB7D4;margin-bottom:16px}
.vueme-page .foot-grid ul{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px;font-size:15px}
.vueme-page .foot-bottom{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;border-top:1px solid #2C2742;margin-top:56px;padding-top:24px;font-size:14px;color:#BDB7D4}
.vueme-page .wordmark-xl{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.06em;font-size:clamp(80px,17vw,240px);line-height:.8;color:var(--yellow);margin-top:56px;user-select:none}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:24px;transform:translate(-50%,20px);opacity:0;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:var(--pill);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;z-index:90;transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s var(--ease);pointer-events:none;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.vueme-page .wa-fab{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:50;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:#25D366;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.vueme-page .wa-fab svg{width:28px;height:28px}
@media (max-width:1024px){.vueme-page .nav-links{display:none}
.vueme-page .nav-menu{display:grid}
.vueme-page .nav-end .btn{display:none}
.vueme-page .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}

}
@media (max-width:640px){.vueme-page .wrap{padding:0 16px}
.vueme-page .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}

}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.vueme-page *,.vueme-page *::before,.vueme-page *::after{transition-duration:.01ms!important;animation-duration:.01ms!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}

}
.vueme-page .i{width:1em;height:1em;flex:none}
.vueme-page .phone{--w:300px;position:relative;width:var(--w);aspect-ratio:9/19.2;border-radius:calc(var(--w)*.15);background:#0E0B1A;padding:calc(var(--w)*.035);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(14,11,26,.45),inset 0 0 0 2px #2b2640}
.vueme-page .phone-notch{position:absolute;top:calc(var(--w)*.05);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:28%;height:calc(var(--w)*.075);background:#0E0B1A;border-radius:99px;z-index:3}
.vueme-page .phone-screen{position:relative;height:100%;border-radius:calc(var(--w)*.12);overflow:hidden;background:#fff;container-type:inline-size}
.vueme-page .phone-screen > .dc{height:100%;overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.vueme-page .phone-screen > .dc::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.vueme-page .dc{font-family:var(--sans);color:#0E0B1A;font-size:4.4cqw;line-height:1.4}
.vueme-page .dc .i{width:5.2cqw;height:5.2cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-photo{border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:var(--acc);color:var(--on-acc);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800}
.vueme-page .dc-initials{letter-spacing:-.02em}
.vueme-page .dc-save{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2cqw;margin:4cqw 6cqw 8cqw;min-height:12cqw;border-radius:99px;background:var(--acc);color:var(--on-acc);font-weight:700}
.vueme-page .dc-socials{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:3cqw;margin-top:4cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-social{width:10cqw;height:10cqw;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#F2F0F7}
.vueme-page .dc-aria{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding-bottom:2cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-aria .dc-cover{align-self:stretch;height:30cqw;background:var(--acc)}
.vueme-page .dc-aria .dc-photo{width:26cqw;height:26cqw;margin-top:-13cqw;border:1.4cqw solid #fff;font-size:9cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-aria .dc-name{font-size:7cqw;margin-top:3cqw;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.vueme-page .dc-aria .dc-role{font-size:4cqw;color:#4a4560}
.vueme-page .dc-aria .dc-bio{font-size:3.8cqw;color:#37324A;margin:3cqw 8cqw 0}
.vueme-page .dc-aria .dc-links{display:grid;gap:2.4cqw;align-self:stretch;margin:5cqw 6cqw 0}
.vueme-page .dc-aria .dc-links span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3cqw;min-height:12cqw;padding:0 4cqw;border-radius:3.5cqw;border:.4cqw solid #E6E3EE;font-weight:600}
.vueme-page .dc-bento{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2.4cqw;padding:12cqw 4cqw 4cqw;background:#F3F1F8;align-content:start}
.vueme-page .dc-tile{background:#fff;border-radius:5cqw;padding:3.6cqw;display:flex;gap:2cqw;align-items:center;font-size:3.7cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-me{grid-column:span 2;gap:3cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-me .dc-photo{width:16cqw;height:16cqw;font-size:6cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-me b{display:block;font-size:5.4cqw;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-me span{font-size:3.6cqw;color:#4a4560}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-acc{background:var(--acc);color:var(--on-acc);flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:1.6cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-acc .dc-k{font-weight:700}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-acc i{font-style:normal;font-size:3.2cqw;padding:.8cqw 2.4cqw;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-map{position:relative;overflow:hidden;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:flex-end;min-height:30cqw;background:#E7F0E4}
.vueme-page .dc-mapgrid{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 46%,#fff 46% 54%,transparent 54%),linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 60%,#fff 60% 66%,transparent 66%),linear-gradient(35deg,transparent 48%,#d6e6d1 48% 52%,transparent 52%)}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-map .i,.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-map span{position:relative}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-map .i{color:var(--acc);width:7cqw;height:7cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-map span{font-size:3.2cqw;font-weight:600}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-bio{grid-column:span 2;font-size:3.6cqw;color:#37324A}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-act{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;font-weight:600}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-act .i{color:var(--acc)}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-save{grid-column:span 2;margin:0;border-radius:5cqw;gap:2cqw;display:flex}
.vueme-page .dc-bento .dc-url{grid-column:span 2;text-align:center;font-size:3.2cqw;color:#5B5670;padding:2cqw 0 4cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-spot{background:#0E0B1A;color:#fff}
.vueme-page .dc-spot .dc-hero{position:relative;height:96cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-spot .dc-hero .dc-photo{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:0;font-size:24cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-spot .dc-fade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 40%,#0E0B1A 96%)}
.vueme-page .dc-spot .dc-id{position:absolute;left:6cqw;right:6cqw;bottom:4cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-spot .dc-id b{display:block;font-size:8cqw;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.05}
.vueme-page .dc-spot .dc-id span{font-size:3.8cqw;color:#D9D4EA}
.vueme-page .dc-spot .dc-bio{margin:2cqw 6cqw 0;font-size:3.8cqw;color:#D9D4EA}
.vueme-page .dc-spot .dc-row{display:flex;gap:3cqw;margin:5cqw 6cqw 0}
.vueme-page .dc-spot .dc-round{flex:1;aspect-ratio:1;max-width:16cqw;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--acc);color:var(--on-acc)}
.vueme-page .dc-spot .dc-list{margin:5cqw 6cqw 0;display:grid;gap:2.6cqw;font-size:3.8cqw;color:#E7E4F2}
.vueme-page .dc-spot .dc-list div{display:flex;gap:2.6cqw;align-items:center}
.vueme-page .dc-spot .dc-social{background:#221d36;color:#fff}
.vueme-page .dc-bau{position:relative;background:#FFF8E1;overflow:hidden}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-shapes i{position:absolute;display:block}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-shapes i:nth-child(1){width:56cqw;height:56cqw;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc);top:-20cqw;right:-16cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-shapes i:nth-child(2){width:30cqw;height:30cqw;background:#0E0B1A;top:16cqw;left:-8cqw;transform:rotate(18deg)}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-shapes i:nth-child(3){width:0;height:0;border-left:16cqw solid transparent;border-right:16cqw solid transparent;border-bottom:26cqw solid #FCC305;top:6cqw;left:30cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-head{position:relative;padding:44cqw 6cqw 0}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-head .dc-photo{width:20cqw;height:20cqw;border-radius:4cqw;font-size:7cqw;border:1cqw solid #0E0B1A}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-head b{display:block;font-size:9.4cqw;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin-top:3cqw;text-transform:uppercase}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-head span{display:inline-block;margin-top:2cqw;font-size:3.6cqw;font-weight:700;background:#0E0B1A;color:#fff;padding:1cqw 3cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-bio{position:relative;margin:4cqw 6cqw 0;font-size:3.8cqw}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2cqw;margin:5cqw 6cqw 0}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-grid span{display:flex;gap:2cqw;align-items:center;min-height:12cqw;padding:0 3cqw;border:.6cqw solid #0E0B1A;font-weight:700;background:#fff}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-save{border-radius:0;border:.6cqw solid #0E0B1A;box-shadow:1.4cqw 1.4cqw 0 #0E0B1A;position:relative}
.vueme-page .dc-bau .dc-social{background:#fff;border:.5cqw solid #0E0B1A;border-radius:0}
.vueme-page .pc{--pc:#6B3FD8;position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:90/53;border-radius:1.6%/2.7%;background:#fff;color:#0E0B1A;overflow:hidden;container-type:inline-size;font-family:var(--sans);box-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(14,11,26,.08),0 18px 40px -16px rgba(14,11,26,.35)}
.vueme-page .pc.pc-round{border-radius:7%/11.9%}
.vueme-page .pc .i{width:3.4cqw;height:3.4cqw;color:var(--pc)}
.vueme-page .pc-band{position:absolute;background:var(--pc)}
.vueme-page .pc-top{position:absolute;left:7cqw;top:9cqw;right:7cqw;display:flex;gap:3.4cqw;align-items:center}
.vueme-page .pc-mono{width:11cqw;height:11cqw;border-radius:2.4cqw;background:var(--pc);color:var(--on-pc);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;font-size:4.4cqw;letter-spacing:-.03em;flex:none}
.vueme-page .pc-logo{width:11cqw;height:11cqw;object-fit:contain;flex:none}
.vueme-page .pc-id b{display:block;font-size:5.6cqw;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.05}
.vueme-page .pc-id span{font-size:3.1cqw;color:#4a4560;font-weight:600}

What is a Vueme digital business card?

A mobile-friendly web page with your photo, contact details and social links. It has its own link and QR code, so anyone can open it on their phone without an app.

How quickly do I get my digital card?

Instantly. Your card link and QR code appear right after successful payment, and you can edit the card any time from My Account.

What does the Analytics add-on show?

Views, QR code scans, link taps, call taps and saved contacts, in a private dashboard only you can see. It switches on automatically after payment.

How long is the digital card valid?

The card is billed yearly. Renew before it expires to keep it live; if not renewed, the card becomes inactive until you renew.

Which paper types do you offer for printed cards?

Matte, Gloss and Synthetic, in single side or front and back. Rounded corners are available on Matte and Gloss for ₹100.

How are printed cards shipped?

By India Post Speed Post with tracking. We add the tracking number to your order and email it to you once shipped. We deliver within India only.

Which payment methods do you accept?

UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking and wallets through PayU. Cash on delivery is not available.
